metadata.name: gigawatt
metadata.description: Gigawatt: hold the token, own the compute. WATT credits, GWATT holder rewards, on-chain ask book.

instructions.name: activate
docs: Burns `amount` WATT (minus activation fee sent to treasury_watt). Off-chain credit = net / 1e6 $.

instructions.name: buy_watt
docs: User pays `usdc_amount` USDC: fee → treasury, rest → funding wallet; mints (usdc_amount − fee) WATT.

instructions.name: cancel_ask
docs: Return remaining escrow to the seller and close the ask.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claim rewards for `flush_index` into the claimant's WATT ATA.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: Double-claim prevention: `init` fails if this PDA already exists.

instructions.name: claim_and_activate
docs: Claim rewards and activate them in one step: fee → treasury_watt, net burned straight from the vault.

instructions.name: fill_ask
docs: Buyer pays price × amount USDC to the seller plus `buyer_fee_bps` to the treasury, receives WATT.

instructions.name: flush
docs: Keeper records a rewards flush: mints `watt_for_holders` to the rewards vault and stores the Merkle root.

accounts.name: watt_mint
docs: WATT mint: PDA so the address is deterministic; authority = config PDA.

instructions.name: place_ask
docs: Escrow `amount` WATT at `price` (USDC atoms per 1 WATT).

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidBps
errors.msg: Fee in bps is out of range

errors.name: AddressMismatch
errors.msg: Account address does not match config

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the treasury USDC / WATT ATAs.

fields.name: funding_wallet
docs: Owner of the funding USDC ATA (1:1 backing of WATT).

fields.name: total_rewards
docs: WATT minted to the rewards vault for GWATT holders.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: WATT claimed out of the rewards vault.

fields.name: total_usdc_in
docs: USDC that entered the funding wallet (purchases net of fee + flush share).
